book.name: KUHALAWA
book.title: KITABU CHA IKABILI CHA MUSA KIKEMIGWA KUHALAWA

content: Waislaeli Wotendeligwa Ukaini Muisi ya Misili
Gano gago matwaga ga wana wa kimbigalo wa Islaeli, ayo vivija yakemigwe Yakobo, wacholile Misili hamoja na heyo, kila imwe na wanage.
Wakala Lubeni, Simioni, Lawi, Yuda,
Isakali, Zabuloni, Benjamini,
Dani, Naftali, Gadi, na Asheli.
Wanhu wose wavumbuke mulukolo lwa Yakobo wakala malongo saba hamoja na Usufu yakalile yeshile kuwa muisi ya Misili.
Vukibitile kipigiti kitali, Usufu hamoja na wandugu zake wose na mulelo uja wose wadanganhika,
ila Waislaeli wakala walelile na kongezeka ng'hani na kuwa na mhiko, avo isi yose ikala imemile hewo.
Milao bwando hamwande kalawilila mndewa iyagwe muisi ya Misili yakalile hatangile chochose kiyatendile Usufu.
Kawalongela wanhu zake, “Loleni, Waislaeli wongezeka ng'hani na wana mhiko kutubanza tweye.
Natutende nzila ya kuwatenda sambiwongezeke kubanza vino viwali. Na kamba hatutenda avo, ihalawilila ng'hondo, woilumba na wadumuka zetu na kugomba na tweye na kusegela kulawa muisi yetu.”
Avo Wamisili wawekila Waislaeli wanhu wa kuwagaza giladi wawagaze mkuwasang'hanikiza sang'hano ndala. Waislaeli wazenga miwambo ya Pitomu na Lamesesi iwe makano ga Falao.
Ila vija Wamisili viwakalile woiyoha kuwagaza ng'hani, vivo Waislaeli viwakalile wokongezeka na kwenela, avo Wamisili wawadumba ng'hani Waislaeli.
Avo Wamisili wawasang'hanikiza Waislaeli bila kuwonela bazi,

na kuwatenda mazua gose wawe na usungu sama ya sang'hano ndala za matofali na chokaa ya kuzengela na sang'hano zose za mmigunda. Wamisili wawasang'hanikiza bila kuwonela bazi msang'hano zose ziwatendile.
Falao kawalagiza Shifla na Pua, wang'hunga wakalile wowataza watwanzi wa Kieblania kulela, yolonga,
“Muhawataza watwanzi wa Kieblania mkipigiti cha kulela haja mkigoda cha kulelela, muhona mwana yovumbuka mbigalo, mkomeni, ila kamba yahawa mtwanzi, mulekeni.”
Ila waja iwang'hunga wakala womdumba Mulungu, avo hawatendile kija Falao kiyawalagize, na waja iwana wa kimbigalo hawawakomile.
Abaho Falao kawakema waja iwang'hunga kawauza, yolonga, “Muwaleka wana wa kimbigalo wawe wagima. Habali mtenda vino?”
Wamwidika Falao, wolonga, “Watwanzi wa Kieblania si kamba viwali watwanzi wa Kimisili, hewo wana mhiko. Wolela kipigiti tweye wang'hunga hatunavika.”
Avo Mulungu kawatendela ganogile waja iwang'hunga, na Waislaeli wongezeka na kuwa na mhiko.
Na kwavija waja iwang'hunga wakala womdumba Mulungu, kawagwelela wana zao wenyego.
Abaho Falao kalagiza wanhu zake wose, yolonga, “Kila mwana mbigalo yondayaleligwe mwa Waeblania, mwaseni Mulwanda lwa Naili, ila yahaleligwa mwana wa kitwanzi, mulekeni.”

footnotes.text: Hano watwanzi hawapetigwe muna imheta ya wanhu wano malongo saba.
Falao nhegulo yake mndewa wa Misili.
